### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2024.3.0

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Core

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/hunterdouglas_powerview/

i suspect the culprit is this one (need time to chuck this into a dummy server). 

Capabilities 11 is not documented and appears to have a "light" feature aswell (under positions).
powerType '12' also does not match the API documentation I was provided previosuly (this should be 0=Battery/1=Hardwired/2=Rechargable). What power source are these set as ?
Thesea are also reporting position information as null - this is different to the other shades (always between 0 and 1)

Below are the shade capabilites that exist currently - could you describe these shades in the context of this table ?

**Additionally** - shades ``"type" : 53`` are not documented in the upstream api (but should work if the type 95 didnt exist). Could you tell me the `Friendly Name` for these so they can be named correctly in Home Assistant (This is how shades appear as either ``Type 8`` or ``Top Down Bottom Up``

If you are able to - getting up to date swagger documentation could help too
```
1. Enable swagger with http://<gateway IP>/gateway/swagger?enable=true
2. Go to http://<gateway IP>:3002/
3. F12 to dev tools and force cache refresh (shift F5) and look for swagger-ui-init.js
4. Extract the options var that contains the swagger doc.
```
![image](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/assets/7148670/194eb982-d608-4f4c-bec8-0b42c88d19e0)

**Capabilities**
_From the swagger docs_
> Type 11 - Illuminated Shades (added in V473)
> Example: Aura Illuminated Vignette, Aura Illuminated Sonnette, and Aura Illuminated Designer Roller
> Uses the "primary,", "secondary," and "light" control types

https://www.hunterdouglas.com/enhancements/aura

Type 11 represents a shade from the Aura Illuminated line. In terms of your Capabilities table, it is `Dual Shade Overlapped` plus light control. Physically, it is a sheer front shade, an opaque rear shade, and a light strip in between.
The schema for the `light` position explains how to control it and interpret its value.

Also of note, the docs claim
> A value of null indicates the Shade is offline

So, because my shade has nulls, it should be interpretted as offline.

**Power Type**
Agreed, `powerType` value 12 doesn't show up in my documentation. I believe it is hardwired. I have asked my Hunter Douglas contact for clarification on this value.

**Type/Friendly Name**
* `53`: Sonnette
* `95`: Aura Illuminated, Roller

**Swagger Docs**
[hunterdouglas_powerview_swagger.json](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/files/14655129/hunterdouglas_powerview_swagger.json)

Here's the latest documentation on `powerType` that will be corrected in a future version of the swagger API.
>PowerType: type: integer description: | Identifies the Shade power source * 0 = Battery * 1 = Hardwired * 2 = Rechargeable * 11 = fixedRechargeable (added v3.1.475) * 12 = fixedWired (added v3.1.475) A "fixed" type is a value locked by the Shade and cannot be changed by the HunterDouglas mobile apps

@kevinjoshai  i will make it so they support basic functiuonality, but light control wont be possible just yet

Confirming these are non-tilt if i can too, and if they are tilt, confirming 90 or 180 degree movement
@kingy444 Correct. None of the shades in the Aura Illuminated product line support tilt.
